$comment: One category per skill. `needs` is what a project must hold for the skill to start; `standalone` is true when that list does not include ARCHITECTURE.md. `depends_on` is every other skill whose files this skill loads (code, data) or whose scripts its instructions run; `optional_depends_on` the ones it runs without — never loaded by code, and every instruction line that invokes one says "optional" and what happens without it. Both are held to the tree by scripts/check-skill-catalog.ts, so a new cross-skill coupling fails `bun run check` until it is declared here. `bun scripts/check-skill-catalog.ts --report` prints the files behind each edge: the inventory for splitting the plugin by category. `agents` maps every agents/**/*.md to the skill that dispatches it; its invocations count as that skill's edges.

categories.intake: Business input before any architecture exists — the PO Spec and its BIAN mapping.
categories.records: Decision and debt records — ADRs and TDRs, kept in adr/ and tdr/.
categories.authoring: Writing and maintaining ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/ — the core the other categories read.
categories.governance: Checks over a written architecture — compliance contracts, risk analyses, requirement coverage.
categories.delivery: Artifacts handed to other teams and tools — handoff kit, Word export, blueprints.

architecture-capability-alignment.note: The judge and the DOM / CAP registry are sa-skills'; without them the alignment is ranked by term overlap and carries no Diagram ID Segments.

architecture-definition-record.note: Catalog mode (.sa-skills/adr-catalog.json) maintains the institutional catalog itself. Generating ADRs from an architecture needs architecture-docs.

architecture-docs.note: Workflow 1 creates ARCHITECTURE.md from the three gates; every other workflow needs it.

architecture-lifecycle.note: Status, release check, release, tag recovery, deprecation — lifecycle.js; a release is the tag architecture-v{version}, so a project outside git cannot be released.

architecture-index-export.note: Build packs need a handoff kit of the same architecture version (handoffs/); without one the bundle carries the chunks and the ledger only.

architecture-ci-setup.note: An architecture repository (ARCHITECTURE.md) or a service repository bound to one (.architecture.json); GitHub Actions only.

architecture-video.note: Renders with HyperFrames (bunx hyperframes, Chrome, the network at render time); without it the storyboard and the project are still built.

sa-ux.why: a UX layer of Claude Code mods: installed by whoever wants it, never as a dependency, and released on the mods' own cadence
